failure_patterns.pattern: answer_format: Answers missed the expected canonical form through excess specificity, name-component or honorific choices, number, or an unnecessary introductory word.

rejected_edits.content: For people, give the full customary canonical name rather than only a surname, but do not automatically copy every middle initial or generational suffix appearing in a source. Include a conventional honorific such as “Sir” when direct context establishes it, even if the clue does not restate it; do not add unsupported titles. When the answer slot asks who, return the bare name rather than an introducer such as “by.”
rejected_edits.target: For people, give the full name rather than only a surname; include an honorific when the clue explicitly signals it, such as “knighted” requiring “Sir,” but do not add unsupported titles.
